snippet.title: Zoo Life Simulator – Official Teaser | Wishlist on Steam! 🦒
snippet.description:
Welcome to Zoo Life Simulator! 🦒🐘
Build your dream zoo from scratch, care for your animals, satisfy visitors, and expand your park. Play solo or with friends in co-op!

🎮 Wishlist Zoo Life Simulator on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874220/Zoo_Life_Simulator/

About the Game:
Zoo Life Simulator is a detailed management & simulation game where you create habitats, hire staff, and unlock new animal species as your zoo grows. 

📌 Follow us for updates:
🐦 Twitter: https://x.com/HiraruGames
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/BENHbKR5e6
